name: Mackenzie
testimony: Meeting people who shared the same struggles reminded me that I’m not alone. Hearing their stories of resilience, growth, and vulnerability was incredibly validating. It reminded me that we all have our own paths, and that community and compassion are what keep us going. The tech world can sometimes feel harsh, competitive, and uncertain, but GHC showed me that support, collaboration, and shared understanding matter so much more.

name: Aayushi
testimony: Embracing the spirit of Unbound helped me realize the power of being a woman in tech. That energy now guides my journey and inspires me to keep growing, learning, and lifting others with me.

name: Jasmine
testimony: I left with new ideas and so much excitement for the intersection of psychology and technology. But more than anything, I left with a sense of confidence I have never had before. I left with friendships that feel real and meaningful, with connections that I know will stay with me, and with a heart that felt full in a way I did not expect. GHC was not just a conference for me. It was the moment I finally let myself believe that I belong in tech.

name: Emily
testimony: Grace Hopper made it clear that tech touches every part of society, and meeting so many inspiring women showed me the power of community in shaping its future.

name: Chloe
testimony: GHC 2025 truly inspired me and changed my perspective in many ways. I had the chance to explore a wide range of topics through the talks and workshops, and I met incredible people - many of whom I was able to connect with on a deeper level, something I rarely experience at conferences. I’m beyond grateful to Ada’s Team and the donors who made this trip possible. It was by far the best conference I’ve attended, and I’m so proud to be a UofA student who got to experience it.

name: Diya
testimony: I met peers who share my passions, mentors who offered guidance, and collaborators I hope to work with again in the future. It was a reminder that I am not on this journey alone and that with community, support, and determination, there is no limit to what we can achieve.

name: Kennedy
testimony: Grace Hopper Celebration left me encouraged, allowed me to grow, and made me more capable. It helped me understand the impact I want to make and showed me that there is a place for people who care about technology and social good. I am grateful that Ada’s Team made this possible and hopeful that future students will have the chance to experience the same sense of possibility that I felt.

name: Kashish
testimony: At GHC, watching strong women lift each other up was powerful. Meeting people from all over the world, fellow international students, researchers, engineers, founders, reminded me how big and diverse the tech world truly is. The more I talked to people, the more I realized that many of us share the same fears, dreams, and doubts.

name: Divya
testimony: Attending this conference has helped me with my career goals since not only was I able to connect with companies that I would like to work for in the future but also with other professionals and students in the technology space. Hearing other people’s stories on how they broke into tech was really motivating and inspiring and it showed me that everyone’s paths look different. Hearing about their journeys, challenges, and motivations pushed me to think more broadly about the kind of engineer I want to become and the impact I hope to create.

name: Mark
testimony: GHC 25 helped me create meaningful relationships with many folks in the tech industry, through their networking events, throughout the talent expo, and in casual settings throughout the week. I got to speak with people in different walks of life, from students to senior engineers, working across different industries, and learn about their work and interests.

name: Caly
testimony: I felt like there was more of a place for me in tech after meeting so many amazing, passionate, and talented women in this field. I experienced a community that supports and uplifts one another, an environment that I feel is exceptionally rare. I left Chicago with a renewed excitement for different tech pathways and the confidence to continue pursuing my career in this field.
